shared_elements: quadruped/mammal head with eye rendered as a carved oval
repeated linear incised patterning as surface fill
justification: Both surfaces depict animals in profile relief with incised linear detailing, but that is essentially all they share: A shows a multi-register composition of small schematic creatures (a row of hooded/arched forms, a striding quadruped, a bird-like figure, a long-necked bird, snake- or plant-like linear motifs) stacked in bands, while B is a single large, naturalistic ram-like head with curling horn and densely modelled fleece filling the whole field. The relationships (registers of many small separate creatures versus one isolated dominant beast) and the schematic-versus-naturalistic conventions are quite different, so nothing suggests a shared iconographic scheme.
